description: Chat-path faithfulness items (Phase 0.3). Each item retrieves live contexts via /query, assembles an FE-parity RAG prompt, calls /chat/stream, and scores the streamed answer's faithfulness to the provided contexts. 'kind' = grounded (answer IS in the corpus) or thin (deliberately NOT in the corpus — faithful behaviour is to decline rather than fabricate). 'grounded' items reuse a subset of the 0.1 golden queries. Seeds the SAME eval-fixture corpus as the retrieval harness.
